description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of six distinct categories, accompanied by a legend in the top-left corner titled "Categories" that provides the raw numerical counts for each group. The chart is composed of six slices arranged in descending order of size, moving counter-clockwise from the top vertical axis. The largest segment is labeled "chat" (light red) and represents 41.2% of the total. Continuing counter-clockwise, the subsequent slices are "math" (light blue) at 21.9%, "tooluse" (light green) at 11.6%, "multi turn chat" (light orange) at 9.3%, and "code" (light purple) at 9.0%. The final and smallest slice corresponds to "instruction follow" (light pink) at 6.9%, though its external text label is partially obscured by a blurred grey rectangular overlay. All category labels and their respective percentages are positioned outside the boundaries of the pie slices. The chart does not feature any visually emphasized, exploded, or offset segments.
